neighbours.label: a figure or number changing level (rises, increases, grows, falls) at the change verb and its following 'to'
fire: The average commute is 40 minutes, and this number climbs to an hour in winter.
Membership stood at 3,000 last year and is expected to grow to 5,000.
Only 12% of shoppers used the app in 2019, but this share increased to 30% by 2022.
The fee is $20 per month, a cost that rises sharply after the first year.
About 400 students enrolled, and the total is projected to double by 2030.
Unemployment reached 9% in March and jumped to 11% in May.
The gap between the two groups widens each year after graduation.
Ticket prices were £15 last season and went up to £22 this season.
quiet: The average commute is 40 minutes, and this number is printed in the city report.
Membership stood at 3,000 last year and is listed on the club website.
Only 12% of shoppers used the app in 2019, according to this share of the survey.
The fee is $20 per month, a cost that covers parking and cleaning.
About 400 students enrolled, and the total is shown in the table below.
Unemployment reached 9% in March, the ministry said in a statement.
The gap between the two groups is described in chapter three.
Ticket prices were £15 last season and are printed on the back of the card.

notes: Card: rises, increase(s/d), rose, 'projected to' grow, all after a figure/number subject. Probe: 'this figure rises to' 0.87, 'falls to' 0.52, 'is listed' 0.19, so the label covers change in either direction, mostly increase. Near misses keep the figure with a static verb.
